How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Start with a little warm-up first, then place Pebble at the angle that already feels natural with your hand. Begin on the lowest suction, explore around your most sensitive area before centering it, then add vibration or increase intensity one step at a time. A tiny bit of water-based lube around the outside can help, but keep it out of the suction opening.
